name: StyleGAN2-based Discriminator Integration
definition: Adapts a StyleGAN2 discriminator to evaluate NeRF-rendered images, configured for 64x64 RGB images with specific channel and resolution parameters.
summary: StyleGAN2-based Discriminator Integration adapts a StyleGAN2 discriminator to evaluate 64x64 NeRF-rendered images, distinguishing real from generated outputs via adversarial loss.
